name: mediainfo
description: Comprehensive multimedia file analysis tool for extracting technical and metadata information

tools.description: Extract detailed technical and metadata information from video, audio, and image files
tools.usage:
MediaInfo.exe video.mp4 # Show detailed media information
MediaInfo.exe --Output=JSON video.mp4 # JSON format output
MediaInfo.exe --Output=XML audio.mp3 # XML format output
MediaInfo.exe --Inform="General;%Duration%" video.avi # Extract specific field
